feature.title: Export audit hardening
feature.description: Require authenticated users before exporting audit records.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users cannot export audit records.

rfc.background: Audit exports contain sensitive operational records.
rfc.featureDescription: Keep export behavior available only to authenticated users.
rfc.expectedOutcome: Anonymous callers receive a 401 and no export body.

requirements.statement: Audit export must reject unauthenticated requests.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Anonymous callers cannot download audit export data.
